findings.claim: No test covers the order 'unknown id before no-field' (edit with an unknown id and no option), which AC-4 and the plan's risks state.
findings.failure_scenario: If edit_task checked 'nothing to edit' before looking up the id, `edit 99` would print `error: nothing to edit` instead of `error: no task with id 99` and every test would still pass, because the unknown-id cases always pass --title or --priority.
findings.evidence: assert_error(path, capsys, before, "error: no task with id 99", "edit", "99", "--title", "x")
